tools.name: search_wines
tools.description: Search the wines currently for sale. Returns price, size, tasting notes, accolades and scores, spice pairings, vineyards and the product URL. Read-only; to buy, use the wine's url.

tools.name: get_wine
tools.description: Get one wine by its slug (from search_wines). Read-only.

tools.name: list_events
tools.description: List upcoming public events and tastings with dates, venue, cost and a booking link. Read-only; it cannot reserve anything: book at the booking_url (Tock).

tools.name: get_visit_info
tools.description: Address, hours, phone, how reservations work, and the wine club link. Read-only.
